name: Polynomial Isomorphism & Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the recognizable 3-coloring modular constraint with an isomorphic but opaque algebraic condition that evaluates to the exact same truth table for the given domain. Simultaneously obscured the lexicographical objective by replacing the explicit base-4 polynomial sum with a sequential accumulator process, forcing the model to independently deduce that greedy first-solution backtracking is optimal to avoid TLE.
